<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def pl(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
def candles(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='p':
            cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.append((min(cs),max(cs)))
    return sorted(out)

print("after: player",pl(f2),"candles",candles(f2))
